name: build
description: The /build:build unattended build workflow: six locked roles (executor, frontend, reviewer, consult, judge, docs), one review skill whose findings a judge verifies and scores on impact and likelihood, the frontend, backend and docker gates, the code docs writer, the codex and agy delegation commands, a stop guard hook that keeps an open build running, plus the launch scripts, the ledger tool, and the shared contracts they all read.
